lookRules: 光源は炎。 基調は熾火の橙、溶けた赤、煤の黒。差し色に熱で白く飛んだ光。冷たい色は使わない。夜と火事をテーマ。

【構図】やや縦長の、キャラクターひとりのイラスト。様々な角度から捉えた動きのある構図。動作の途中。はっきり読み取れるシルエット。頭を上寄せにして、画面の大部分を被写体が占める。

Art Style: Japanese anime cel-shading style. Clean cel shading layered with soft gradients. Confident and distinct line art with thick main contours and thin internal detail lines. Large eyes with meticulously drawn irises and highlights. Clear skin with minimal shading, glossy highlights in the hair. Vivid, highly saturated colors. Expressive and readable facial features. Finished to the quality level of mobile game key art.
Screen Usage: The artwork fills the canvas edge to edge. Do not draw borders, margins, vignetting, or a backing mount. Do not place important elements within 5% of any edge. The bottom quarter of the frame must remain quiet background without faces or main subjects; this area is reserved for effect text to be overlaid later, but do not draw any banners, plates, or text boxes in the image.
Elements to Exclude: Do not include text, letters, numbers, subtitles, signatures, watermarks, or logos. Do not include card frames, borders, UI components, or status icons. Do not draw banners, ribbons, or translucent panels meant for text. No speech bubbles, comic panels, collages, or split screens. Do not display multiple poses of the same character like a character design sheet.
Appearance: An 18-year-old female. Tall with a toned, lean body. Long scarlet hair worn down loose without being tied up. Amber eyes. Wearing armor. Burn scars on both hands and shoulders. An aura of the academy's top sword prodigy whose sharpness has transformed directly into ferocity.
Scene: Hair streaming upward in an updraft, charging forward while readying a blade completely enveloped in flames. A trail of fire left behind her stride.
Background: A night where a town is burning to the ground. The only light source is the flames.
Shared Deck Aesthetics: The light source is fire. Base palette of ember orange, molten red, and soot black. Accented with white-hot light from intense heat. Do not use cool colors. The theme is night and fire. Visuals of power are unified as flames and sparks. Wherever power is active, dancing sparks and drifting ash must appear. Do not use magic circles or symbols. The setting darkens according to the progression of the town burning down: 1-2 cost tier is the bright fire of a town where people still live; 3-4 cost tier is a town beginning to burn; 5 cost and higher is a burned-down black night where only fire glows. Differentiated by burn scars: people of Igna have old burn scars somewhere on their skin, hair ranging from scarlet to reddish-brown, and amber eyes; Belze and Veld have bodies that are beginning to turn into fire itself.
Composition: A slightly vertical illustration of a single character. A dynamic composition captured from an engaging angle in mid-action. Clearly readable silhouette. The head is positioned toward the top of the frame, with the subject occupying most of the screen.
